description.value: This study investigated cerebral glucose metabolism and 5-HT2A receptor binding in patients with the frontal variant of frontotemporal lobar degeneration, comparing apathetic and disinhibited behavioral syndromes with healthy control subjects.

spans.text: We studied cerebral glucose uptake using (18)F-fluorodeoxyglucose and positron emission tomography in 18 patients fulfilling clinical criteria for fv-FTLD and showing, respectively, an apathetic or disinhibited behavioral syndrome.

description.value: This was an observational, cross-sectional PET study comparing patients with fv-FTLD behavioral syndromes with healthy control subjects.
